name: web-app-save-reopen
description: Save a live website as a web app and reopen it after restarting the browser.
given: Uranus Browser on an iPhone or iOS simulator with access to a live site such as Squoosh.
when: Open the page menu, choose Share then Save as Web App, tap Add and Open, close the web app, and relaunch Uranus Browser.
then: The saved app appears on the new tab page and opens again from its tile.
validates: site manifest, web app presentation, and persistence
